svg.title: The whole course on one pipeline. A question is rewritten (step 2, part 1), turned into numbers and adjusted by an adaptor (step 4, part 2), searched by meaning (step 1, part 1), and reranked against the original question (step 3, part 2) before the top 5 go to the AI. Start with reranking: it runs locally and needs no training. Train an adaptor only once real users give feedback.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
